desc: Nerevarine never saw the Dragon's tail. The Loveletter already arrived. And so, Nerevarine returned to their journey in relief. This is now merely a memory, sinking into the depths of the sea.
Hatred is peace. I AM AND YOU ARE ALL ME. The Doom Drum keeps on beating, still repeating Lorkhan's failure. This failure has been predestined.

The brass giant marches to victory. As the Dwemer fled from their own existence, so the brass giant denies everything. The magic word is MAYBE. This is why the brass giant affirms it in the end. There is no Wheel and no Lull beyond that.

A follower of Hircine attacked the orphanage and turned orphans into beasts. It's regrettable, but there is no cure. Put them out of their misery.
Beasthood: +1
Insight: +1

A few musketeers have been cursed by Hircine, making them lose their sanity. Protect their honor and hunt them down.
Beasthood: +2
Insight: +2

Those driven by doubt and fear are indiscriminately attacking anyone wandering these streets. Hunt them down for the sake of this city's safety.
Beasthood: +2
Insight: +1

Ever since darkness fell over Pailune we have been seeing a strange cat with an eyeball pattern on its fur. Something terrible will happen if nothing is done about it. Hunt it down before it's too late.
Insight: +2

A pale sac of flesh washed up from the sea, and now monsters are being born from it. Destroy it before it multiplies even further.
Insight: +2

Find and dispose of those infected by the curse of Hircine. There is a distinct smell of death about them.
Humanity: +1
Insight: +2

Dispose of the beast-possessed citizens. We should no longer protect these people.
Beasthood: +1
Insight: +1

Those who bow willingly to the curse of Hircine become even more fearsome beasts. Hunt them down as a priority for the safety of our citizens.
Beasthood: +3
Insight: +1

Dispose of the followers of Hircine invading the city. Prove who is the hunter and who is the prey, them or us.
Beasthood: +2
Insight: +1

The cursed drift here from across the land, searching for more curses. But only one can stand on the Blue Star. Destroy each other to your heart's desire.
Beasthood: +1
Insight: +2

What's Radiance? What's Hatred? What's Peace? Oh, don't make me laugh. I'll kill you again and again, grind you down, stomp all over you, and turn you all into dumb, mute sacks of shit.
Insight: +3

Aushahlaas is sleeping peacefully. Yet the curse still ceaselessly consumes him and threatens to invade even his dreams. 
Now it spills over and mingles with his peaceful sleep. It takes on a different form and flies away on shadowy wings, into the Garden of Kyne.
Humanity: +3
Insight: +2

Let us laugh when we kill and laugh when we are killed. For that is the meaning of mortality.

Which course will you choose?

Devour Ja'bal and take its curse upon yourself?
